cases.sentence: Не радуйся, Израиль. Не ликуй, как другие ___.
cases.translation: Don't rejoice, Israel, to jubilation like the nations.
cases.explain: The nations are the grammatical subject in comparison with as, taking nominative case.

cases.sentence: Ту любишь заработок блудниц на каждом ___.
cases.translation: You love the wages of a prostitute on every grain threshing floor.
cases.explain: The preposition на (on) governs the prepositional case when indicating location.

cases.sentence: Ефрем вернется в Египет и будет есть нечистую ___ в Ассирии.
cases.translation: Ephraim will return to Egypt, and they will eat unclean food in Assyria.
cases.explain: The transitive verb есть (eat) governs the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Такие жертвоприношения будут для них как хлеб на ___.
cases.translation: These sacrifices will be like bread at a funeral.
cases.explain: The preposition на (on, at) with prepositional case indicates location/occasion.

cases.sentence: В праздничные дни Господа, даже если вы избежите истребления, Египет соберет вас, а ___ похоронит.
cases.translation: In the festival days of Yahweh, even if you escape destruction, Egypt will gather you, and Memphis will bury you.
cases.explain: Memphis is the grammatical subject of the verb will bury, taking nominative case.

cases.sentence: Ваши сокровища из серебра зарастут ___, и жилища — терновником.
cases.translation: Your treasures of silver will be overgrown with thorns, and your dwellings with thistles.
cases.explain: The verb зарастут (will be overgrown) takes the instrumental case for the covering agent.

cases.sentence: Пусть знает это ___. Вы считаете пророка глупцом.
cases.translation: Let Israel know this. You consider the prophet a fool.
cases.explain: Israel is the grammatical subject of the implied 'know', taking nominative case.

cases.sentence: Я нашел Израиль, как виноград в ___. Я увидел ваших отцов, как ранний плод инжира.
cases.translation: I found Israel like grapes in the wilderness. I saw your fathers as the first ripe fruit of a fig tree.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) governs the prepositional case when indicating location.

reading.ru: Не радуйся, Израиль. Не ликуй, как другие народы, потому что ты не был верен своему Богу.
reading.question: Why is Israel told not to rejoice like other nations?
options: Because they were unfaithful to their God
Because they were poor and weak
Because God loves the other nations more
reading.correct: Because they were unfaithful to their God
reading.explain: The text states Israel should not rejoice 'потому что ты не был верен своему Богу' — because you were unfaithful to your God.

reading.ru: Ефрем вернется в Египет и будет есть нечистую пищу в Ассирии.
reading.question: What will Ephraim be forced to do?
options: Return to Egypt and eat unclean food in Assyria
Build new temples in the wilderness
reading.correct: Return to Egypt and eat unclean food in Assyria
reading.explain: The text explicitly states that Ephraim will return to Egypt and eat unclean food in Assyria.

reading.ru: Такие жертвоприношения будут для них как хлеб на похоронах. Каждый, кто будет есть его, осквернится.
reading.question: What will the sacrifices be compared to?
options: Bread at a funeral that defiles those who eat it
reading.correct: Bread at a funeral that defiles those who eat it
reading.explain: The sacrifices are compared to bread at a funeral, which defiles anyone who eats it.

reading.ru: Давай же Господи! Что же мне у тебя попросить для них?
reading.question: What does this cry express?
options: Despair and not knowing what to ask God for them
reading.correct: Despair and not knowing what to ask God for them
reading.explain: The cry 'Дай им, Господи! Что же мне у тебя попросить для них?' expresses a desperate question of what to ask God for Israel.

reading.ru: Будущее славы Ефрема улетит, словно птица. Не будет ни рождения, ни беременности, ни зачатия.
reading.question: What will happen to Ephraim's future glory?
options: It will fly away like a bird, and there will be no birth or conception
It will shine brighter than ever
It will be restored in the land
It will multiply among the nations
reading.correct: It will fly away like a bird, and there will be no birth or conception
reading.explain: Ephraim's glory is said to fly away like a bird, and there will be neither birth nor conception.

reading.ru: Из-за всего их зла в Гилгале я там возненавидел их. Из-за их злых дел я изгоню их из моего дома.
reading.question: What will God do because of their evil in Gilgal?
options: Drive them out of His house
reading.correct: Drive them out of His house
reading.explain: Because of their evil deeds in Gilgal, God says 'я изгоню их из моего дома' — I will drive them out of my house.
